bugs.title: "Has" VN filters never compiled into API predicates
bugs.symptom: Toggling hasAnime/hasScreenshot/hasDescription/hasReview produced identical result sets
bugs.rootCause: buildVnFilter omitted the four boolean flags despite them existing in VNFilterState
bugs.resolution: Compile each flag to ['has_*','=',1]; regression test added

bugs.title: searchrank sort active without a search filter
bugs.symptom: Relevance sort without a query returned unintuitive ordering
bugs.rootCause: API documents searchrank relies on a present 'search' filter
bugs.resolution: Degrade searchrank -> rating when the query is blank

bugs.title: Random quote batch collapsed to one response by in-flight dedupe
bugs.symptom: N requested quotes returned N duplicates of one quote
bugs.rootCause: Identical request payloads intentionally share one in-flight promise
bugs.resolution: Single query with an or-chain of ['random','=',1'] x N

bugs.title: List-row busy flags read non-reactively
bugs.symptom: Edit/remove spinners missed updates
bugs.rootCause: useUlist.getState().busy read during render is not a subscription
bugs.resolution: Shelf subscribes to the busy map and passes flags via props

bugs.title: devstatus badge comparison unreachable under strict types
bugs.symptom: In-development/TBA marker could never render
bugs.rootCause: '1|2 !== 0' no-overlap after truthiness narrowing
bugs.resolution: Explicit undefined + 0 checks

bugs.title: Tag inclusive toggle offered non-API semantics
bugs.symptom: ANY/ALL promise not supported by id-inclusion for tags
bugs.resolution: Removed toggle; includes are AND

bugs.title: Wide layout toggle had no CSS effect
bugs.rootCause: html[data-wide='true'] overrides were never authored
bugs.resolution: Added .max-w-* overrides; Shell applies attribute

bugs.title: Dead default React imports across 17 modules
bugs.resolution: Removed; named hook imports kept

bugs.title: react-router advisories (open redirect, SSR deserialization)
Guest shelf lookup typed as scalar while API returns a map
bugs.resolution: useGet<Record<string, UserInfo | null>>

bugs.title: Staff credit grouping dropped aid used for link targets
bugs.resolution: Group map typed as VnStaffEntry[] end-to-end

bugs.title: Nonexistent mock API in client tests
bugs.resolution: Explicit default implementation instead of getImplementation()

bugs.title: package-lock.json out of sync with package.json — npm ci fails everywhere
bugs.symptom: npm ci aborts (EUSAGE): lockfile pins (@vitejs/plugin-react@4.7.0, typescript@5.6.3, zustand@5.x) do not satisfy package.json; README quick start, Netlify/Vercel builds and CI all break
bugs.rootCause: Dependencies bumped in package.json without re-running npm install
bugs.resolution: Lockfile regenerated; npm ci exits 0

bugs.title: npm run lint crashes — undeclared ESLint dependencies
bugs.symptom: eslint exits ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND for typescript-eslint; npm run verify and the CI lint gate unusable
bugs.rootCause: eslint.config.js imports typescript-eslint and eslint-plugin-react-refresh, neither declared; @eslint/js used directly but only transitive; @typescript-eslint plugin+parser declared but unused
bugs.resolution: Added devDeps typescript-eslint@^8.57, eslint-plugin-react-refresh@^0.5.5, @eslint/js@^9.17; removed unused @typescript-eslint/* deps; eslint . --max-warnings 0 clean

bugs.title: VN 'Has description' filter was dead state — no UI toggle, no URL mapping
bugs.symptom: hasDescription existed in VnFilterState and buildVnFilter but was unreachable: readState/writeState dropped it and the panel had no toggle (regression against SOD-001 prevention rule)
bugs.rootCause: Toggle and URL param removed during UI rework while the state field stayed
bugs.resolution: Pure URL sync extracted to lib/vndb/vnFilterUrl.ts with desc=1 in both directions; Description toggle restored; round-trip unit tests

bugs.title: Single-child boolean filters sent to the API (documented 2+-child contract)
bugs.symptom: With all roulette constraints cleared the spin posts ["and",["id",">=",…]] — one child; F.and()/F.or() with a single argument and single language/trait selections produce the same shape; kana documents and/or as 'followed by two or more other predicates'
bugs.rootCause: No normalization pass between filter builders and the transport layer
bugs.resolution: normalizeBooleanGroups() collapses single-child/empty boolean groups (semantically neutral); applied at construction, in andAll, and defensively in VndbClient.query; unit tests

bugs.title: Platform enum drift vs live API schema (wrong + missing codes)
bugs.symptom: Map carried codes the schema does not have (snes, dc, 3ds, xsx) and missed live ones (ps1, sfc, drc, n3d, xxs, wiu, sw2, tdo, msx, smd, scd, pcf, p88, fm7, fm8, x1s, xb1); badges fell back to raw codes; the Releases Xbox Series X/S chip posted platform=xsx which the API rejects
bugs.rootCause: Enum hand-curated from memory, never re-validated against GET /schema
bugs.resolution: PLATFORMS rewritten to the live 47-code set (2026-08); tests assert every live code resolves and renamed codes are gone

bugs.title: Media enum drift (mro invalid; mrt/cas/dc/mem missing)
bugs.symptom: mediaTypeName fell back to raw codes for live media values; mro is not in the live enum
bugs.resolution: MEDIA_TYPES aligned to the live schema; tests added

bugs.title: MyList Shelf remounted on every write — edit modal closed mid-save, view state reset
bugs.symptom: Editing labels+vote+dates+notes closed the modal after the first successful PATCH; sort/page/label/search state reset after every write
bugs.rootCause: Shelf keyed by user.id:refreshTick and ulist.bump() fires per successful guard; key-remount was the refetch mechanism
bugs.resolution: Remount removed; Shelf subscribes to refreshTick and calls useApi.reload() in place

bugs.title: Tag chips & relation chips caused full page reloads
bugs.symptom: TagList and RelationChips rendered raw <a href="/g/…"> anchors — browser document reloads instead of SPA navigation
bugs.rootCause: react-router Link not used in the chip renderers
bugs.resolution: Replaced with Link; styling preserved

bugs.title: searchrank sorted ascending in six surfaces (inconsistent with releases page)
bugs.symptom: reverse:false with sort=searchrank is worst-match-first under the documented 'reverse=true sorts descending' rule; ReleasesBrowsePage used reverse:true — at most one could be right; additionally /v?sort=<junk> reached the API unvalidated
bugs.rootCause: Default sort direction assumed per-field rather than the documented ascending default
bugs.resolution: searchrank always paired with reverse:true (palette/characters/producers/staff/tags/traits); URL sort param coerced through SORT_PARAM_WHITELIST

bugs.title: Dead ternary in HomePage daily-picks memo
bugs.symptom: unique(out.map(v=>v.id)).length === out.length ? out : out — both branches identical
bugs.rootCause: Leftover of an earlier dedupe attempt
bugs.resolution: Simplified; unused unique import dropped

bugs.title: CSV export vulnerable to formula injection
bugs.symptom: Shelf CSV export quoted delimiters but not leading =,+,-,@ or tab; notes/titles opened in Excel/LibreOffice/Sheets could execute as formulas (OWASP CSV injection)
bugs.rootCause: Escaping covered delimiters only
bugs.resolution: csvCell moved to lib/utils with formula-cell neutralization (leading apostrophe); unit tests

bugs.title: Regex lookbehind in markup renderer crashed old Safari at parse time
bugs.symptom: renderTextWithEmphasis used (?<![\w/]) — a SyntaxError at script parse on Safari <16.4 / Firefox <78, taking down the whole bundle despite the es2020 build target
bugs.rootCause: Lookbehind assumed universally supported
bugs.resolution: Manual scanner replicating the same boundary rules; emphasis unit tests

bugs.title: Docs claimed 'no fonts CDN' while index.html loads Google Fonts
bugs.symptom: External-effects scan contradicted the shipped index.html (Google Fonts: Cinzel/Inter/Shippori Mincho B1/JetBrains Mono/Source Serif 4)
bugs.resolution: REPO_ANALYSIS Phase 2 corrected; both third-party touchpoints (fonts CDN, t.vndb.org art) disclosed

bugs.title: CI existed only as docs/examples/ci.yml — nothing wired up
bugs.symptom: No .github/workflows directory; the quality gates (tsc, eslint --max-warnings 0, vitest, build, audit) never ran on push/PR
bugs.resolution: Hardened workflow at docs/examples/ci.yml and staged at .github/workflows/ci.yml; enabling requires a one-file copy with a workflows-capable token (GitHub App scope blocked in sandbox)

bugs.title: Birthday 'Day' input silently ignored without a month
bugs.symptom: Day typed with no month selected was dropped by buildCharacterFilter (birthday filter requires the month)
bugs.rootCause: Day input not coupled to month selection
bugs.resolution: Day input disabled until a month is chosen, with tooltip and aria-label hint

bugs.title: Failed re-login wiped an active session; login did not clear previous account's cache
bugs.symptom: auth.login failure called vndb.setToken(null) even when a valid user was signed in (silent deauth, store/client token mismatch); switching accounts kept the prior account's cached reads
bugs.rootCause: Login failure path assumed no prior session
bugs.resolution: Previous token restored on failure; cache cleared on successful identity swap

bugs.title: Circular sign-in pointers (ListPanel ↔ Settings ↔ My Shelf)
bugs.symptom: ListPanel sent guests to /settings to sign in, but Settings says to sign in from /list
bugs.resolution: ListPanel links to /list (the actual sign-in surface)

bugs.title: Impossible dates parsed successfully and rendered 'undefined'
bugs.symptom: parseVndbDate accepted 2022-13-05 / 2022-02-31 → MONTHS[12] undefined in formatVndbDate
bugs.rootCause: Regex validated shape only, not calendar ranges
bugs.resolution: Month 1-12 and day ≤ days-in-month (leap-aware) enforced; invalid → 'Unknown'; tests

audit: Second full-pass audit. Verified against live kana docs (api.vndb.org/kana) and schema (api.vndb.org/kana/schema) on 2026-08-29.
